summary: Evotec SE furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Interim Statement for the first nine months of 2026 and a related corporate news release, an ordinary quarterly results disclosure rather than a special situation. Reported group revenue fell 13.1% to EUR 465.0m, adjusted Group EBITDA was negative EUR 44.3m, and full-year 2026 guidance of EUR 570-610m revenue was reaffirmed. The filing also notes the CSO transition, with Dr. Cord Dohrmann stepping down effective September 30, 2026 and Dr. Joanna Holbrook appointed effective November 1, 2026; no deal, stake, premium or closing terms are stated.
